caption: The drawing depicts a wooden furniture piece, specifically a chest or dressing table with six drawers and one central cabinet door. The overall color of the wood is a reddish-brown with darker shading to indicate grain and dimensionality. Ornate brass or gold-colored handles and escutcheons are attached to each drawer and on the top middle drawer. Decorative fan or shell-shaped carvings are present on the upper three sections, above each set of drawers and in the center above the door. The legs of the piece are shaped in cabriole style, and the bottom is raised off the ground. The central door also features a carved fan motif and appears to swing open to reveal an internal compartment. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or cream color.
title: Table (Knee Hole)
